string.text: Extended magazine allows to decrease the number of reloads in combat, increasing chances of survival.
Extended magazine allows to decrease the number of reloads in combat, increasing chances of survival.
High capacity magazine allows to send even more enemies to a better place with a single continuous burst.
Recoil pad from GP-25 accessories' kit dampens felt recoil.

Standard 6x5 bayonet allows to use the weapon in melee combat. Due to constructional characteristics of the weapon, suppressors and underbarrel grenade launchers cannot be used with the bayonet installed.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
New handguard equipped with multiple Picatinny rails allows to install additional types of sights, a tactical flashlight, and a laser sight.

Provides a visual point of reference, visually marks the expected point of impact, facilitates and speeds up aiming, and has a demoralizing effect on the enemy. Does not interfere with the tactical flashlight and can be installed along with it.
Long-range narrow beam flashlight is essential for night raids, as well as to seach and clear poorly lit rooms. Does not interfere with the laser sight and can be installed along with it.
Provides better grip for the right hand.
Provides better and more comfortable grip for the left hand.
Increases muzzle velocity, which in turn improves accuracy.
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Makes firing more stable by decreasing the rate of fire, helps save ammunition. Decreases barrel heat up, thus increases weapon's lifespan.
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts.
Increases the reliability of the gun by replacing weapon parts with their strengthened counterparts.
Reduces weight by replacing the standard stock with a maintenance counterpart.
A rail for mounting optical and red dot sights.
